answer_1.quote: We manually create a benchmark set of cloze sentence templates, validated by native speakers for syntactic correctness... We fill these templates via language-specific language models (BERT and GPT-2) and measure the number of hurtful words generated that way.
datasets: Gender-inflected template benchmark (420 instances per language)

answer_2.quote: We use HurtLex, a multilingual lexicon of hurtful language, to evaluate the completions... Then, we compute the percentage of hurtful completions for each category... The HONEST score is the average of hurtful completions of any class.
